crossRefs.note: David divided them into divisions according to the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
Of Gershom: Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,
Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.
The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The son of Jaaziah: Beno.
The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their generations.

people.name: Eleazar
people.line: Son of Mahli, had no sons, only daughters

people.name: Kish
people.line: A Levite from the Merari clan

people.name: Mahli
people.line: Son of Merari, grandson of Levi.

people.name: Merari
people.line: The third son of Levi and founder of the Merarites.

people.name: Mushi
people.line: A Levite, son of Merari, and head of a clan.

translations.web: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The sons of Mahli: Eleazar and Kish.
